title: MCP Elicitation Support, Improved Hooks, and Performance Updates
description: Claude Code added MCP elicitation support for interactive dialogs, new Elicitation and ElicitationResult hooks, worktree sparse paths support for large monorepos, PostCompact hook, and numerous bug fixes including deferred tools losing schemas after compaction.

community_feedback.quote: The past seven days confirmed what developers have been saying - Claude Code dominates and MCP goes mainstream

title: Student Plan Launch and Major Agentic Improvements for JetBrains
description: GitHub Copilot introduced a new Student plan for sustainable Copilot experience for students. Major agentic capabilities improvements for JetBrains IDEs: Custom Agents (GA), Sub-agents (GA), Plan Agent (GA), and Agent Hooks (preview with MCP auto-enablement). Network configuration changes for Copilot coding agent also took effect.

community_feedback.quote: They're rebranding the free tier as the 'GitHub Copilot Student' plan, which is just the budget version
Students with .edu email can access over $2,000 worth of free tools including GitHub Copilot - completely free

title: 30+ New Plugins, Automations, JetBrains IDE Support, and MCP Apps
description: Cursor added more than 30 new plugins from partners including Atlassian, Datadog, GitLab, Glean, Hugging Face, monday.com, and PlanetScale. Introduced automations for always-on agents, JetBrains IDE support via ACP, MCP Apps with interactive UIs, team marketplaces for plugins, and Bugbot Autofix.

title: GPT-5.4 Model Support and Cascade Performance Improvements
description: Windsurf added GPT-5.4 support with limited-time promotional pricing (No Reasoning: 1x, Low: 1x, Medium: 2x, High: 3x, Extra High: 8x credits). Fixed Apple M5 support, improved Cascade UI performance, fixed dangling Diff Zones for Jupyter Notebooks, improved notifications for model price changes, and added support for loading SKILL.md files.

community_feedback.quote: How do the GPT-5.4 models compare to others so far? The pricing shows GPT-5.4 High Thinking at x8 credits

title: PWA Installation, Datadog MCP Integration, and On-Demand Session Insights
description: Devin can now be installed as a Progressive Web App on desktop and mobile. Added Datadog MCP integration, on-demand session insights (with auto-generation for L/X sessions), inline voice recording button, session @mentions, pinned sessions sidebar, structured output modal for API sessions, and native Markdown preview.

title: Version 0.114.0 with Experimental Code Mode and Hooks Engine
description: OpenAI Codex CLI v0.114.0 introduced experimental code mode for isolated coding workflows and a new hooks engine for workflow customization. Also includes performance improvements, clearer remote error messages, Windows terminal copy-paste fixes, and security updates including pnpm version updates for CVE-2026-24842.

title: March 2026 Updates with File Outline and Built-in Skill Creator
description: Gemini Code Assistant released updates including file outline and finish changes features now available in VS Code and GA. Added built-in skill creator for automatic tool generation with security consent prompts, PTY shell support, and auto browse feature with user confirmation before action.

community_feedback.quote: Users describing the March 2026 updates as 'insane' and transformative
